source.query: AREA[LeadSponsorClass]INDUSTRY AND AREA[StudyType]INTERVENTIONAL AND (AREA[Phase]PHASE2 OR AREA[Phase]PHASE3) AND AREA[StartDate]RANGE[2010-01-01,2024-12-31]

groups.industry: Industry-led trials with no Regeneron lead or collaborator.
groups.sponsor_collaborator: Regeneron listed as collaborator, partner leads (for example Sanofi-led dupilumab trials).
groups.large_sponsor_peers: Context subset of industry: lead sponsors with >= 200 analysed trials (raw names).

dimensions.outcomes: Registered primary + secondary + other outcome measures.
dimensions.eligibility: Non-empty criteria lines (same rule as PeerMirror); excluded from the composite because abridged 'key criteria' postings undercount.

definitions.expected: Mean over the trial's MeSH disease categories of the industry median for the same phase and category (>= 20 reference trials); otherwise the industry median for the phase.
definitions.ratio: observed / expected; 1.0 = as expected for phase and disease area.
definitions.composite: Geometric mean of the outcomes, countries and sites ratios.
definitions.periods: 3-year blocks by registered start date; 'all' pools 2010-2024.
definitions.phases: Phase 2, Phase 2/3 and Phase 3, each with its own expectation; Phase 1/2 records matched by the query are excluded.

caveats: Registry fields are sponsor-reported and incomplete; counts are proxies for protocol complexity, not the protocol itself.
A ratio above 1 is a question for the design team, not a quality judgment; complexity can be scientifically justified.
Phase and MeSH category do not capture indication severity, endpoint type or regional strategy; residual case-mix differences remain.
Blocks with fewer than 10 trials are flagged; read their intervals, not points.
